evidence.quote: if (end < start) throw new DomainError("validation", "to must not be before from");

rules.statement: The weekly report period end date ('to') must not be before its start date ('from').
rules.subject: weekly report period end date

rules.statement: Only paid bookings count towards tickets sold, members admitted and hire income in the weekly report; refunded bookings are counted separately as refunds.
rules.subject: booking status counted as tickets sold

rules.statement: A session counts as held for ice if its status is 'held', or if it has an ice hold and has not been cancelled; a cancelled session counts as cancelled for ice.
rules.subject: session ice-hold classification
